title: Shyam Premi SN
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm festive colours, glowing diyas, vertical friendly centred composition, no text, no letters, no writing
endline: Apne parivaar ko bhejein 🙏 | Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN
mantra_source: Bhagwan Vishnu ka dwadashakshar mantra (Shrimad Bhagwat parampara), Dev Uthani Ekadashi ke liye

scenes.prompt: Divine darshan of the Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam Baba: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels with festive red roses, glowing diya light, a festive decorated temple sanctum
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya light gently pulses and a few rose petals drift in the foreground
scenes.line: बाबा श्याम के जन्मोत्सव की बधाई
scenes.tts: बाबा श्याम के जन्मोत्सव की आप सबको बधाई! जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Baba Shyam ke Janmotsav ki aap sabko badhai! Jai Shree Shyam!

scenes.prompt: Devotees with folded hands carrying saffron and blue flags walking towards the glowing Khatu Shyam temple at dusk, lamps lit along the path, fresh flower garlands, peaceful golden sky, joyful devotional mood
scenes.animate: the flags flutter gently in a soft breeze, the lamps flicker and the camera slowly glides forward
scenes.tts: हारे का सहारा, बाबा श्याम हमारा!
scenes.sub: Haare ka sahara, Baba Shyam hamara!

scenes.prompt: Bhagwan Vishnu awakening from yoga nidra on the coiled Sheshnag in the ocean of milk, Maa Lakshmi beside him, four arms with conch, chakra, mace and lotus, a tulsi plant and lit clay diyas in the foreground, soft golden dawn light, serene
scenes.tts: देवउठनी एकादशी की शुभकामनाएँ। ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय।
scenes.sub: Dev Uthani Ekadashi ki shubhkamnayein. Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya.

scenes.tts: अपने परिवार को भेजें। जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Apne parivaar ko bhejein. Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN. Jai Shree Shyam!
